appearances.title: ggml v0.29.0 adds FP8 E4M3, per-row flash attention and early multi-node tensor parallelism
appearances.summary: New OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type, ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows (each query slice attends to its own K/V rows), batched tensor copy APIs, and a multi-process communicator for multi-node tensor parallelism. Backend work includes SVE CPU kernels, fused MoE MMQ in CUDA, faster MXFP4 mat-vec in Metal and Vulkan split-K tuning.
